ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expressive vocals and melodic pop fit my interest in vocal albums; I would try this now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The soulful pop appeals to me, but I would choose just one Adele album this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dark Side Of The Moon; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent classic rock listening makes this a strong choice for a full album listen.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hybrid Theory; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavier sound does not fit the melodic classic rock and folk I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: American Idiot Import       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for energetic punk rock this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: St. Anger       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The aggressive metal sound is outside my current listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Appetite For Destruction       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy classic rock, but this harder-edged album is less appealing right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The vocal duets appeal to the same interest that drew me to Cheek to Cheek.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its heavy, dramatic rock style is not what I am seeking today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Master of Puppets; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Thrash metal does not match my current preference for gentler melodies and familiar classic rock.
